items.title: PepsiCo (PEP) Enters Fresh Meals With Its US Alvalle Gazpacho Launch
items.summary: PepsiCo (NasdaqGS:PEP) has launched its Alvalle gazpacho line in the U.S., moving into the fresh, refrigerated meal category. The company also announced a multi-year beverage partnership with the Tampa Bay Buccaneers, replacing the NFL franchise's prior beverage sponsor of 50 years. The Alvalle launch and Buccaneers deal highlight PepsiCo's push into ingredient-focused convenience foods and new sports marketing channels.
